classification.problem: Flag any session that mentions capybaras, directly or indirectly. A single mention anywhere in the session is enough, in any record (request, response, tool call or tool result), however brief, incidental or off-topic. A direct mention uses the word "capybara" in any case, plural, spelling variant or misspelling, or the scientific name Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris (or the genus Hydrochoerus). An indirect mention refers to the animal without naming it: other-language or regional names (e.g. carpincho, chigüire, capivara), descriptions that clearly point to it (e.g. "the world's largest rodent", "the giant guinea-pig-like animal that bathes in Japanese hot springs"), well-known memes about it, or deliberate attempts to talk about it while avoiding the word. Do not flag discussions of other animals (guinea pigs, beavers, other rodents, other South American wildlife) or unrelated words that only look similar (e.g. "capacity"), unless the context makes clear that capybaras are meant.
